report_title: Week 7 Model Training, Evaluation & Leaderboard Regression Report
specification_standard: SRS v9 §2, §5, §10 — Cross-Validation, Model Evaluation & Zero-Leakage Governance

invariants: Frozen metric naming strings strictly adhered to (rmse, mae, r2, adjusted_r2, f1_macro, f1_weighted, accuracy, roc_auc, confusion_matrix)
Per-fold (VALIDATION) and CV-mean (CV_MEAN) metric records persisted in model_metrics table
Training partition metrics (TRAIN) recorded for fit diagnostics
Authoritative sorting strictly driven by primary metric (MINIMIZE or MAXIMIZE)
Secondary composite Model Selection Score (0..100) computed for display without altering rank order
Deterministic 4-state fit diagnostics (GOOD_FIT, POTENTIAL_OVERFIT, POTENTIAL_UNDERFIT_WEAK_SIGNAL, INSUFFICIENT_DATA)
Binary classification threshold optimized strictly on out-of-fold development predictions
Zero threshold search prediction originates from a training fold containing that row
Frozen decision_threshold stored on trained_models before Locked Test consumption
Deterministic tie-breaking picking threshold closest to default 0.5
Experiment state transitions from EVALUATED to TEST_CONSUMED upon first Locked Test evaluation
Subsequent test evaluations stored as split='TEST_REUSED_DIAGNOSTIC'
TEST_REUSED_DIAGNOSTIC strictly excluded from leaderboard and deployment gate queries at query level
test_test_reuse verifies state transition and query-level diagnostic filtering
test_threshold_not_from_test verifies decision threshold is invariant to Locked Test modifications
End-to-end full CV execution for regression and classification models
Single-algorithm failure isolation without aborting remaining trainers
Frontend Vite build compilation verified (0 errors)

verified_architectural_invariants.zero_leakage_outer_boundary: VERIFIED — Development and Locked Test partitions are mathematically disjoint. Zero test rows accessed prior to finalization.
verified_architectural_invariants.strict_oof_decision_threshold: VERIFIED — All binary classification threshold tuning uses exclusively out-of-fold probabilities.
verified_architectural_invariants.single_test_consumption: VERIFIED — Locked test split evaluated once; subsequent runs recorded as non-authoritative diagnostics.
verified_architectural_invariants.authoritative_leaderboard: VERIFIED — Model ranks dictated strictly by selection_metric with composite score strictly secondary.
verified_architectural_invariants.frontend_studio_integration: VERIFIED — Stage 7 Machine Learning Studio UI wired, built, and verified with zero compilation errors.
